class.name: SourcePPResolver
class.brief_description: Resolves Source Engine assets from registered local installs and Steam game VPKs.
class.description:
[SourcePPResolver] wraps the bundled SourcePP file-system layer and exposes a higher-level Godot API for Source game content lookup. It can register local Source installs or Steam apps, build per-search-path maps of VPK-backed entries, return the owning VPK path for a virtual asset path, and read files such as [code]models/props/crate.mdl[/code] directly from registered content. Classes such as [SourcePPMDL] and [SourceAnimPlayer] can use a resolver instance to fetch companion assets from VPKs instead of requiring loose files on disk. [codeblock] var resolver := SourcePPResolver.new() resolver.register_steam_game(220, "hl2")
var mdl := SourcePPMDL.new() mdl.resolver = resolver mdl.open("models/props_c17/oildrum001.mdl") [/codeblock]

method.name: clear
method.description: Unregisters all currently registered games and clears all cached entry maps.

method.name: get_entry_map
method.description: Returns a nested dictionary of [code]game_id -> { entry_path: vpk_path }[/code] for the requested Source search path.

method.name: get_file_vpk_path
method.description: Returns the VPK path that contains [param file_path], or an empty string if no registered game contains it. If [param game_id] is empty, registered games are searched in registration order.

method.name: get_registered_games
method.description: Returns registered game IDs in the order they will be searched when no explicit game ID is provided.

method.name: has_file
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the requested virtual file exists in one of the registered search roots. If [param game_id] is empty, registered games are searched in registration order.

method.name: read_file
method.description: Reads the requested virtual file from a registered Source install or VPK and returns its bytes. If the file is not found, an empty array is returned. If [param game_id] is empty, registered games are searched in registration order.

method.name: register_local_game
method.description: Registers a local Source game folder containing [code]gameinfo.txt[/code]. The stored game ID is derived from the folder name.

method.name: register_steam_game
method.description: Registers a Steam Source game using the provided Steam app ID and the game directory name that contains [code]gameinfo.txt[/code], such as [code]portal2[/code] or [code]hl2[/code].

method.name: unregister_game
method.description: Unregisters the requested game ID. Returns [code]true[/code] if a registration was removed.
